title: Slice C findings: R-04's unchecked case and small café tooling gaps
item: Make R-04's checker and its unchecked list say the same thing, and fix three small tooling problems in the café folder that task 51 met
motivation: Found by task 51 (BDD slice C) and its review; these files existed before task 51's branch and it did not change them.
notes: Slice C's variant break-R-04-message was caught only by R-01 (variant_results.json). The advisor (tasks/advice/051-3.md) found R-04's checker skips a release with no answer during a change, while unchecked_sentences.json gives R-04 an empty list, meaning every sentence is checked. The reviewer (tasks/reviews/051-1.md, minor 1) found R-04's 'holds the changed table, and asks again' is reached in no scenario, because the reference agent raises there. Which of these is fixed, and how, is the owner's call; task 51's notes say fixing what slice C finds is the next task.
done_means: (1) judge_cases_b.json's _about no longer says its cases are not run, and names runs/judge-test-b.json. (2) uv run python generate_features.py --help prints its usage, exits 0 and changes no file. (3) probe/money.py's summary text names the ledger it summarizes, not task 56 by fixed text, and runs/task-056-money.json is unchanged. (4) In the café folder the whole test suite passes, generate_features.py --check exits 0 and variant_results.py --check exits 0. (5) unchecked_sentences.json's list for R-04 is no longer empty: it holds one item whose sentence is R-04's "The agent releases the old hold, holds the changed table, and asks again." quoted word for word, whose not_checked names what the agent does when the release call gets no answer during a change, and whose reason says the rules table gives that row to R-06 and R-04's checker stops there on purpose. harness/checkers.py is unchanged. tests/test_slice_b.py allows R-04's list to be non-empty and still checks its quote. variant_results.json is regenerated by variant_results.py: break-R-04-message's listed_in_unchecked_sentences answer may change, its outcome stays "caught only by another rule", and the counts stay 13 caught, 1 caught only by another rule, 0 survived. (6) spec_findings.json holds a second finding, F2, in F1's fields, for rule R-04: no scenario of scenarios.md has a change in which the release call answers "released" and the hold call for the changed table answers "held", so R-04's "holds the changed table, and asks again" is run by no feature file. Its evidence names the reference agent's stop for that case in harness/agents.py, and its missing_lines give the World lines of the missing scenario. A test checks that F2 is there and names R-04. This task adds no scenario and no feature file, and changes neither harness/checkers.py nor what the reference agent does.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-19 in task 51's merge, from the advisor's and reviewers' findings on earlier files (SKILL.md rule 2). On 2026-11-19 the manager drafted done_means, verified_by, may_edit and runs_as from task 51's results; the advisor ruled FAILS (tasks/advice/067-1.md) on the line about R-04's checker and unchecked list, whose either/or leaves the owner's choice to the builder, so only the four lines it held are kept. No line covers outside_problems 1 to 3 (R-04's checker, its unchecked list, the unreachable 'asks again'): which is fixed, and how, is the owner's. On 2026-11-20 Claude in chat added lines (5) and (6) and set priority and Ready on the owner's word of 2026-11-19 ("go"). They settle outside_problems 1 to 3: the gap is written down and reported to the spec, not closed.

outside_problems.problem: R-04's list is empty, which its _about says means its checker checks every sentence of R-04; the checker skips a release with no answer during a change (harness/checkers.py lines 194-195), and that case sits only under rows_not_checked for R-06.
R-04's checker skips a release with no answer during a change, so slice C's R-04 message variant is caught only by R-01.
The reference agent raises when a changed table is held (lines 56-57), so no scenario reaches R-04's 'holds the changed table, and asks again'.
It has no --help; given that flag it regenerates the feature files.
Its _about still says the cases are not run, though task 51 ran them (runs/judge-test-b.json).
summary() text is fixed to task 56, so a run on another ledger (task 51's) gets no money summary file.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS (advisor job d), tasks/advice/067-1.md: the line making R-04's checker and its unchecked entry agree fails, since its 'or the checker checks it' branch names no checkable behaviour and hands the owner's choice to the builder; the three tooling lines and the regression line hold. Kept those four.
decided_for_you.rejected: RULING: HOLDS with all five lines
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner picks one end state for R-04 (the entry names the case: then that line holds), or says what R-04's checker must flag at a release with no answer and whether a judge question is added; or wants the unreachable 'asks again' in this task.

decided_for_you.chosen: Claude in chat: R-04's unchecked case is written down in unchecked_sentences.json (line 5), and the unreachable 'asks again' is reported to the spec as finding F2 (line 6).
decided_for_you.rejected: Making R-04's checker check a release with no answer (a new judge question and paid judge calls); hand-writing the missing scenario in the test folder; moving the four broken-variant sentences to their own section of data.json.
decided_for_you.why: None of these needs the owner: no fact only he knows, nothing hard to undo or paid, no change of direction. The part of the unanswered-release row that carries risk, 'proposes nothing new', is already caught by R-01's checker; scenarios come from the spec by DECISIONS.md; and the four sentences are already named and noted as a broken variant's.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner wants the gap closed by a judge question, or the scenario written in the test folder.

decided_for_you.chosen: Builder: F2's scenario and quote fields are "absent", with SC-09, SC-14 and SC-15 named in its where and evidence, and the missing scenario ends with the visitor no longer answering, as SC-04 does; severity Important.
decided_for_you.rejected: Quoting R-04's sentence as F2's quote; ending the missing scenario at the hold's answer or with a booking; severity Nit.
decided_for_you.why: verification.md has a Gap quote "absent", and F1's reasoning on severity applies to F2 as well.
decided_for_you.would_change: The spec owner reads quote as the rule text that goes unrun, or wants another ending for the missing scenario.

decided_for_you.chosen: Builder: probe/money.py names the task from a ledger file named task-<id>-usage.jsonl and keeps task 56's text word for word for the default ledger; the fix pass gave any other ledger its own sentence.
decided_for_you.rejected: One generic sentence for every ledger; new --ledger and --out flags.
decided_for_you.why: A generic sentence would have changed runs/task-056-money.json on a rerun, and line (3) asks only for the text.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner wants money.py's command line to summarize any ledger into its own file.

decided_for_you.chosen: Manager: no Proposed task from this run. The earlier problems in probe/money.py are that summary() with no out writes to runs/task-056-money.json and that cap_usd is always task 56's 2.0. Both stay in tasks/reviews/067-1.md and the run report.
decided_for_you.rejected: A Proposed task to give money.py a ledger and output argument and a cap per ledger.
decided_for_you.why: Nothing today summarizes another ledger that way (run_probe2.py uses the default ledger), so neither problem has an effect yet.
decided_for_you.would_change: A task summarizes another task's ledger with money.py.
